_comment: Synthetic example - high risk (Annex III-5(c), risk assessment & pricing in health insurance). Exercises the Annex III(5) sub-point path and the data-governance section (11).
sys_owner: Example Health Insurer N.V. — Product & Pricing team
sys_description: A gradient-boosting model that produces a risk score and a premium band for applicants of a supplementary health insurance package, using application data, historical claims and public area statistics.
intended_purpose: Support underwriters in accepting applicants and setting the premium band for the supplementary package. The basic package is out of scope.
data_sources: Application forms, claims data warehouse, licensed area statistics.
human_oversight: An underwriter sees the score, the top factors and the premium band, and decides; every deviation from the model is logged with a reason.
dg_data_owner: Head of Underwriting (data domain: applications & claims)

dg_datasets.name: Claims history (supplementary package only)
dg_datasets.purpose: Risk features; excluded: basic-package medical data

dg_lineage: Application forms + claims DWH -> dedupe, label, exclude basic-package medical fields (steward) -> train_v3 / val_v3 / test_v3 -> PolisPrijs v3.1 -> risk score + premium band -> underwriting queue
dg_q_evidence: Completeness 98.7% on mandatory fields (DQ dashboard, 2026-08); accuracy: 0.4% error vs. verified sample (DQ-2026-11); representativeness reviewed per age band and region, no metric yet.
